title: News Intelligence source-to-decision high-rigor architecture, source recall and prospective decision-value falsification
question: Using only the hashed source-to-decision packet and current GitHub main, audit why November 3 US midterm was absent from November 4 Situation Room verified event list, test whether the proposed lexical/lookback/completion fixes are causally sufficient or still leave high-impact missing event families. Assess source coverage/terms, first-known clocks, immutable event family ledger, verification queue/latency, daily Director ingestion, read-only official Kompas explanation, Alpha Lab meme protocol/news context, and an event-study design that could falsify any improvement in Compass pullback or 12h/72h/168h forecast accuracy. Identify cheapest reliable P0/P1 repairs and reject handwavy new agents. Include actual source constraints: CFTC RSS disabled, CoinGecko News Analyst+ not a free in-GitHub feed, AP Elections API licensed, official election certification distinct from media race calls. Check cost and provenance of all alternatives.
hypothesis: A bounded, source-admitted event family discovery + verification + consumer chain, followed by pre-frozen outcome evaluation, may improve material news coverage and lower Kompas/Alpha false-negative cost without adding a separate signal engine or trading authority. However no predictive lift is established and current source owner is insufficiently complete.
baseline: B0 incumbent Situation Room six first-party agency landing pages + keyword same-day filter, existing Director research context, frozen NEWSFT B0_HEADLINE_POLARITY / B1_VERIFIED_FACT_IMMEDIATE_REACTION; alternative no-news price/momentum baseline with same as-of information and same cost/alert budget.
falsifier: Original P0 patch still misses election coverage absent a licensed external election source; historical knowledge time cannot be proven; coverage-only increase fails to reduce material-event misses; unverified/duplicated news falsely escalates; event interpretation adds no net value after matched price/macro baselines and review cost; DATE_ONLY converted to fictitious 4h event; Alpha Lab social hype causes false positives.
kill_condition: No actual completed response+first-known clock or insufficient same-time denominator means NO_SCIENTIFIC_EDGE_CLAIM. If source entitlement unavailable or 50 prospective events not met, advisory-only plan and ABSTAIN; no paid-provider bypass, no second paid model call for unchanged evidence.
forbidden: secrets/private raw data in public Git
second paid review of same mission
